# CLARITY: A Framework and Benchmark for Conversational Language Ambiguity and Unanswerability in Interactive NL2SQL Systems

[All reading notes](../reading-notes.md) · [Catalog entry](../README.md#clarity)

**Full paper read · 2026-11-09**

[Original source](https://aclanthology.org/2026.acl-industry.86.pdf) · ACL 2026 Industry Track proceedings, pp. 1218–1250

**Reading coverage:** All 33 pages: sections 1–7; Appendices A–D; all taxonomy/conversation examples, Algorithms 1–9, complete supplied generation/evaluation prompts, Tables 1–26 and reported confidence intervals.

## Research question

Binary ambiguity detection can hide failure to identify the actual schema elements involved, particularly when a request contains more than one ambiguous reference and clarification is incomplete.

## Method

CLARITY extracts SQL-grounded targets, retrieves competing columns or values, generates pivot terms and rewritten questions, and filters them with multiple LLM evaluators. It synthesizes concise, verbose, partial and unhelpful conversation variants and retains pivot-to-target annotations for diagnostic evaluation.

## Evaluation

Spider- and BIRD-derived instances support alternative-SQL prediction, conversation-conditioned SQL generation, and AmbiSQL detection/localization assessment. Three experts validate a stratified 448-instance sample by majority vote. Five LLMs are tested; exemplars with metadata are supplied only in context, not as test labels.

## What the results support

Binary detection is often high while target matching and complete interpretation recovery remain much lower. GPT-5 multi-facet strict exact match increases markedly with metadata-bearing exemplars, but gains and rankings vary by model, category and dataset.

## Limits and qualifications

Conversation-to-SQL evaluation supplies the completed dialogue, so it does not measure a deployed agent choosing and adapting its own questions. Schema-linkability definitions cover a narrower notion than general SQL answerability; an absent value need not make a query semantically invalid. Generated labels and human checks do not prove exhaustive interpretation coverage. The prose excludes value-level SQL evaluation while result tables include value-ambiguity columns, leaving protocol scope unresolved.

## Relevance to reliable Text-to-SQL

Useful for diagnosing the gap between detecting ambiguity and locating or resolving its sources, with controlled multi-facet stress tests rather than unrestricted real-user interaction.
